data.body: CORRECTION to note dsh-vs-aworkit-cache-gap: "Aworkit rewrites its prefix every sixth turn" is wrong. (1) The 17,412-byte penalty is an artifact of commonPrefixBytes comparing raw JSON bytes: tools/stream_options follow messages in the body, so the byte prefix always ends before the ~17.4 KB tools array. The provider still caches tools (median miss 629, not 5,400); measure the rendered message prefix instead. (2) recorded_prefix_tests: 40 of 49 pairs are strict appends, the other 9 differ only at the trailing shell-jobs notice. (3) Probe: repeat X+trailer1 miss 190; X+trailer2 miss 191; X+new+trailer1 miss 198 - a changed or inserted trailing message costs only its own tokens, so the notice cannot explain the big misses. Still true: ~36% of the 162,083 uncached is per-turn novel content (629/turn vs DSH 212); ~58% is ~18 turns crediting only the 12,032-token header despite an identical history, coinciding with the replayed-reasoning surplus flipping 60-90k.
